Files & use.

What do I receive?

2 A4 PDFs · 74 pages each · writable + print. English, undated and licensed for personal use. No physical item is shipped. The complete paid files are not included in the public preview.

Which application do I need?

For the writable edition, use a form-capable PDF reader. Save a copy, enter a short answer, save, close and reopen to test it. Browser and mobile previews vary. The separate A4 print edition has ruled writing areas; print at actual size or use Fit after checking margins.

How do I get support?

Email metal_cook@hotmail.com with your product name and order reference. Never send passwords, payment-card details or private journal answers.

THOUGHTFULLY PUT TOGETHER

What is inside.

  • Six starting worksheets for routine, baseline, process goals, schedule, recording conventions and returning after a break
  • Twelve weekly plans with a four-habit, seven-day tracking grid
  • Thirty-six session logs with six activity rows plus effort and recovery notes
  • Twelve weekly reviews and three block reviews after Weeks 4, 8 and 12
  • Two complete 74-page A4 editions: 764 writable fields and checkboxes, plus a separate print edition
  • Records your chosen activities; does not prescribe exercise, nutrition or medical treatment
